recipes.title: Wheat Milk Bread
steps: Mix the yeast with lukewarm water and a little sugar. Let it rest for 5-10 minutes until frothy.
In a large bowl, combine wheat flour, maida, sugar, and salt.
Add the activated yeast mixture and milk to the flour.
Mix and knead into a smooth, soft dough for 10-12 minutes.
Cover the dough and let it rise until doubled in size (about 1 hour).
Punch down the dough and shape it into a loaf.
Place the loaf in a greased bread tin.
Allow it to proof again for 30-45 minutes until it rises above the tin.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until the top is golden brown.
Remove from the tin and cool completely before slicing.
